title: Third cuboid polynomial irreducibility conjecture
statement: For positive pairwise-distinct integers a,b,c with gcd(a,b,c)=1, bc≠a², and ac≠b², the associated monic degree-twelve third cuboid polynomial P_(a,b,c)(t) is irreducible over the integers.

counterexample.description: Parameters a,b,c in the conjecture's domain and two nonconstant integer coefficient arrays whose exact product is P_(a,b,c)(t).
